texts.text_1: Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations
texts.text_3: Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...
texts.text_4: ...and glue one of them to your moving structure
texts.text_5: Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier
texts.text_6: Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power
texts.text_7: Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator
texts.text_8: The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact
texts.text_9: Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured
texts.text_10: Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted
texts.text_11: Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact
texts.text_12: The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley
texts.text_13: Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board
texts.text_14: Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks
texts.text_15: Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically
texts.text_16: Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor
texts.text_17: This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival
texts.text_18: Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator
